plain.li: [hand] Better a {WEAPON} in my hand than nothing at all.
[hand,melee] I'll take this {WEAPON}, I've had nothing to fight with.
[hand,ranged] I'll carry this {WEAPON}, I've had nothing to fight with.
[sidearm,melee] I'll keep this {WEAPON} at my belt, in case they get close.
[sidearm,melee] Better a {WEAPON} at my side than nothing if it comes to that.
[sidearm,ranged] A {WEAPON} at my side, for the ones who run.
[sidearm,ranged] This {WEAPON} will reach the ones I can't get to.
[sidearm,ranged,lowtech] With this {WEAPON} on my back I can strike before they reach me.
[offhand] This {WEAPON} will do for my other hand.
[offhand,melee] A weapon in each hand now, this {WEAPON} for the second.
[offhand,ranged] Two to shoot with now, with this {WEAPON} in my other hand.
[keep] I'll hang on to this {WEAPON} after all.
[keep,melee] This {WEAPON} stays at my belt from now on.
[keep,ranged] This {WEAPON} stays with me from now on.

warm.li: [sidearm] With this {WEAPON} too I can look after the others better.
[hand] There, a {WEAPON}, now I can stand with the rest of you.
[offhand] A {WEAPON} for my other hand, so I can keep you all safer.

blunt.li: [sidearm,melee] Nothing for close work until now, so this {WEAPON} comes with me.
[sidearm,ranged] Nothing to shoot with until now, so this {WEAPON} comes with me.
[hand] Empty hands are no use in a fight, so I'm taking this {WEAPON}.

cheerful.li: [sidearm] A {WEAPON} of my own to carry, that's more like it!
[offhand] One in each hand, and this {WEAPON} feels just right!
[keep] Oh, I'd forgotten this {WEAPON}, it can stay with me!

gloomy.li: [sidearm] I'll carry this {WEAPON}, for all the good it may do.
[hand] A {WEAPON}, then, since trouble always finds us.

cold.li: [sidearm] The {WEAPON} fills the gap in my kit.
[offhand] The {WEAPON} for the off hand, as it should be.
